=== FINDINGS FROM minimax_minimax-m3 ===
- File: .claude/scripts/usage_limit_resumes.py (and byte-identical workflow-templates/.claude/scripts/usage_limit_resumes.py)
  Line or code reference: is_limit_wait at lines 381-394; the vocabulary check at 385-387 combined with the has_limit_text early return at 388-389
  Problem: is_limit_wait accepts actionable text such as "Usage limit reached. Please retry the request now." because every token is in LIMIT_WAIT_VOCABULARY ("usage", "limit", "reached", "please", "retry", "the", "request", "now") and has_limit_text() matches the `\busage limit reached\b` pattern. The function returns True despite the actionable "Please retry the request now." tail.
  Why it fails at runtime: When a session's needs_action is this string, is_limit_wait returns True, so has_unanswered_request() returns False, and _skip_reason() does not return needs_input. The pickup then creates a "Resume after usage limit" trigger for that session, waking it past the actionable request. The new "not an answer" sentence in the resume prompt (§NOT_AN_ANSWER_TEXT) is a soft guard that the model may override when its context already says "continue from your latest instructions"; the skip-reason path is the real defense and the review-round-1 fix leaves it open.
  SEVERITY: BLOCKER
  ISSUE_CONFIDENCE: 5
- File: tests/test_usage_limit_resumes.py
  Line or code reference: test_is_limit_wait parametrize list at lines 308-334
  Problem: The test does not include a case like "Usage limit reached. Please retry the request now." (composed entirely of vocabulary words that all appear in LIMIT_WAIT_VOCABULARY) in the False-expected group. The new "Only limit-wait words" cases the PR adds (lines 326-331) all use the words "merge", "push", "drop", "run", "fusionner" — verbs NOT in the vocabulary — so they happen to fail the vocabulary check before reaching has_limit_text. The test still passes when the actual bypass is present.
  Why it fails at runtime: CI shows green for a build whose is_limit_wait is unsafe under the very wording that the Copilot review comment at 19:07:33 and four pass-2 reviewers flagged ("Usage limit reached. Please retry the request now." is composed entirely of allowed words and has_limit_text matches). The regression detector for the #6102 fix is therefore incomplete.
  SEVERITY: MAJOR
  ISSUE_CONFIDENCE: 5
- File: .claude/scripts/usage_limit_resumes.py
  Line or code reference: _skip_reason at lines 504-519, specifically the permission-prompt check at 514-516
  Problem: The new code checks needs_action and status_detail for the permission-prompt pattern, but does not check status_category. A session whose permission prompt is recorded only in status_category (not in needs_action or status_detail) falls through to the needs_input and limit-wait branches.
